g.text: 1 · WRITE PATH — a document change becomes a durable event

g.title: cluster_fanout
g.text: 2 · FAN-OUT — one event, four independent jobs

g.title: cluster_read
g.text: 3 · TRUST BOUNDARY — the server decides what may be read

g.title: client
g.text: Holds a token, not a database role

g.title: rule
g.text: Kafka delivers the trigger. The consumer owns the switch.
The server, never the model, decides what a customer may read.
